sections.description:
BytePlugs Invoice Fields Timologio transforms your WooCommerce checkout into a professional billing system. Let customers easily switch between receipt (Apodeixi) and invoice (Timologio) modes, with all necessary fields for business transactions in Greece and internationally.

View Premium Version Features & Pricing

⭐ Key Features (Free Version)

  • Smart Toggle System

    • Intuitive Receipt/Invoice switch at checkout
    • Smooth field transitions
    • Clean, uncluttered interface

  • Essential Invoice Fields

    • Company Name (Eponymia)
    • VAT Number (AFM)
    • Tax Office (DOY)
    • Company Activity
    • Company Address

  • Professional Design

    • 4 Beautiful button templates
    • Customizable colors
    • Mobile-optimized layout
    • Seamless WooCommerce integration

  • Core Functionality

    • Field validation
    • Automatic order meta saving
    • Admin order details display
    • Translation ready

sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘byteplugs-invoice-checkout-fields-timologio’ to your plugins folder
  2. Activate through WordPress plugins menu
  3. Configure button styles in Invoice Fields settings
  4. Invoice fields will appear in your checkout automatically

Quick Setup Guide

  1. Install & activate
  2. Visit Invoice Fields settings menu
  3. Choose your button template
  4. Customize colors (optional)
  5. Test in checkout
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes, this plugin needs WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes! Choose from 4 button templates and customize colors to match your theme.

Does this include AADE integration?

AADE integration is a premium feature. Upgrade to Premium for automatic company information retrieval for Greek companies.

Is it translation-ready?

Yes, the plugin supports translations. Default language is English with Greek strings included.

What about support?

Free version includes community support. Premium users get priority email support.

Can I try before upgrading?

Yes! Install the free version to test core features. Upgrade anytime for AADE integration.
